notes: Incremental stories added to strengthen validation, observability, and failure handling for allowlist routing.

change_log.value: Add strict Pydantic validation and error normalization layer
change_log.note: Close gap on validation consistency and error contract

change_log.value: Add allowlist enforcement guard with explicit rejection paths
change_log.note: Ensure GOV-004 compliance via hard deny of non-allowlisted tools

change_log.value: Add tool routing observability and audit logging
change_log.note: Improve traceability using existing debug logger infrastructure

stories.title: Strict Pydantic Validation and Error Normalization
stories.description: Implement a validation layer that enforces strict schema compliance for all tool inputs and normalizes validation errors into a consistent response format for the LLM loop.

stories.title: Allowlist Enforcement Guard and Rejection Handling
stories.description: Add a guard layer that rejects any tool invocation not present in the allowlist registry, returning structured error responses and preventing execution.

stories.title: Tool Routing Observability and Audit Logging
stories.description: Integrate routing decisions, validation outcomes, and execution results with debug_logger to provide full traceability of tool dispatch behavior.
